rules.when: a worker runs on this runtime
rules.why: Muse renders no trust dialog for a launch, so the gate is never consulted for it. A plain Enter submits. Its composer is a bare prompt glyph, which the shared shape reader recognises without a harness name. One Escape cancels the turn but RESTORES the cancelled prompt into the composer as real text, so the interrupt is not complete until Ctrl+U clears it; otherwise the next submitted line concatenates onto it. The cancellation is acknowledged from its own session event log, not from the screen. A relaunch cannot resume an exact session, so it starts fresh. Muse runs operator and Recon work only. While a turn runs the pane shows its own activity rows; idle it shows its composer. An open run in its bound session log is the busy proof and a settled log is the idle proof, never a rendered footer.
